text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, as I'm passing by the cafeteria,
I see
Copano Rickey surrounded by a
copious volume
of sumo stew.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Oh, hey, Trainer! Actually...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
In feng shui, seasonal ingredients are the
basis of good fortune. ♪ Also, different
ingredients are recommended based on
how exactly you want to improve your
luck.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ooh, like what?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
First up—ingredients that help your
money
fortune! Apparently, yellow
foods like eggs and
fried tofu are best.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
If you want to be lucky health-wise,
green foods are the way to go, though.
Finally, miso soup is like the ultimate
option—it'll boost every kind of
luck!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Wow, that's amazing! And miso-flavored
sumo
stew might taste really good!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I like the sound of that! Why don't
we make it
together?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: So, here it is!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, but having this much means
there's more
happiness to go around! ☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Exactly. Bigger is better—for food and
fortune!
Everything's buono and
happy. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Everything may be buono and happy,
but I still
think this is too much stew for
the number of
mouths we have...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Everything may be buono and happy,
but I still
think this is too much stew for
the number of
mouths we have...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Oh! What a great idea! We really should
share
this happiness with everyone!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Come and get your luck-boosting stew!
If your
tummy's rumbling, eat up and
you'll be happy in
no time! It's our treat!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Luck-boosting stew? ...And it's their
treat?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Oguri! How about trying some of
our
good-luck stew? It'll make you
happy!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Sure, sounds great!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We share the sumo stew with
everyone—with the bulk of it going to
Oguri Cap—and have a great
time filling
ourselves up.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Okay! Time to top up my stomach and
my luck! ☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Munch, munch... Your sumo stew really is the best, Akebono!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
My stomach's full of happiness!
Okay,
I'm ready for my seventh serving!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Copano Rickey continues to chow down
on the stew. She eats so much that she
ends up temporarily immobile, but at
least she's boosted
her luck... probably?
